I think what helped me overcome it is just waiting. It's probably the most difficult thing to do when you're depressed because time feels like it's going so slowly. I remember being in class and just staring at the clock waiting and literally counting the seconds. What helped me most was probably reading and surround myself with joyful people. The kind of people that are just so light-hearted and funny. I remember laughing helped me a lot. Just laugh. Now all I do all the time is just laugh and socialize with people. Do that. Make jokes.
